dhs_household.description:
Auto-generated seed from the ICF DHS Program indicators API, filtered to
household characteristics and social-protection-adjacent categories.
Selection rule: indicators must be derivable from PublicSchema household-level
record data — Household.dwelling_type, Household.cooking_fuel,
Household.electricity_access, Household.floor_material,
Person.education_level, and asset/empowerment slots. Clinical indicators
(HIV, malaria, fertility, anthropometry, immunisation) are excluded.
Labels and definitions are English-only as provided by the DHS API.
concept_uri values are auto-minted per DHS Level2 bucket (see
schema/concept_schemes/dhs_household.yaml); this is mechanical grouping,
not a curated SKOS scheme — see docs/follow-ups/dhs-concept-scheme.md.
Topic mappings and translations are out of scope for this seed and tracked
as TODOs. Calculation blocks are hand-authored for a small number of
indicators (see HAND_AUTHORED_CALCULATIONS in the converter); the rest carry
no calculation block.
dhs_household.license: DHS indicator definitions are publicly available; data downloads require DHS Program registration
dhs_household.source: ICF, The DHS Program — DHS API
dhs_household.title: DHS Program — Household and SP-adjacent indicator seed metric catalog

ilo_sdg.description:
Auto-generated seed from ILO's SDMX 2.1 dataflow registry, filtered to SDG
indicators relevant to social protection delivery. The selection rule is
derivability from PublicSchema record-level data: each kept indicator can be
computed (now or with a small slot addition) from Person.employment_status,
Person.occupation, Person.industry, Person.status_in_employment,
Enrollment in Program, etc. Macro indicators and country-level qualitative
ratings are excluded. Trilingual labels (en/es/fr) come from the SDMX
<common:Name> elements; dimensions and attributes are derived from each
DSD's authoritative DimensionList and AttributeList. Calculations, concept
URIs, and dimension/attribute catalogue definitions are out of scope for
this seed and tracked as TODOs.
